rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese word for the first morning meal or the food served for it.

example.english: I usually have congee and eggs for breakfast.
example.traditional: 早餐我通常食粥同埋雞蛋。
example.jyutping: zou2 caan1 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 sik6 zuk1 tung4 maai4 gai1 daan6

rows.note: A speaker may choose this more conversational variant when referring to breakfast as a meal, especially in 食早飯.

example.english: We’ll have breakfast in a bit and go to work afterwards.
example.traditional: 我哋一陣食早飯，食完先返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 zan6 sik6 zou2 faan6 sik6 jyun4 sin1 faan1 gung1
